name: io.github.YAMA-TANA/calculate-mcp
title: CALCULATE_MCP
description: Deterministic MCP calculator for arithmetic, matrices, calculus, probability, dates, and units.

examples.name: Exact calculations
examples.description: Evaluate arithmetic and high-precision decimal calculations instead of relying on LLM mental math.

examples.name: Matrix and calculus
examples.description: Solve linear systems, invert matrices, differentiate functions, and evaluate definite integrals.

examples.name: Probability and dates
examples.description: Calculate common probability distributions and deterministic calendar or business-day results.
